screener_description: ISGEC Heavy Engineering Ltd is a diversified heavy engineering company engaged in manufacturing and project business with an extensive global presence. It manufactures process plant equipment, presses, Iron & Steel castings & Boiler pressure parts. It also undertakes turnkey projects for setting-up boilers, power plants, sugar plants, distilleries, factories and others. It also has strengths in the business of construction. [1] It is also engaged in the business of manufacture of sugar and its by-products through a subsidiary. [2]
